slices:Politics.what: Anuj playing the people in power or rolling his eyes at them: the government-vs-protesters reel, an official demanding drones, defenders straining to justify nonsense, a bathrobe lounge over a caption.
slices:Politics.why: The big ones have him acting out the powerful with a straight face, the protesters-vs-rapists reel at 338×. The quiet ones are him commenting on news drama, or lounging in the bathrobe while a caption does the joking.

slices:Relationship skits.what: Anuj as the boyfriend in the wrong: dates, fights and girl names in the caption (Sakshi, Khushi, Rhea), plus a few family and friends scenes.
slices:Relationship skits.why: The best is friends acting out fight moves to rap on the pavement, 51×. The weak ones have him lecturing Esha, coaxing an old man about Rahul, or getting body-shamed by his parents. The guy at fault lands better.

slices:Collabs.what: Mostly duets and split screens with Shree, fighting like a couple over money, food and sleep. The rest are streams and street clips with other creators.
slices:Collabs.why: The top three are caption-led Shree bits: money back, begging for food, sleep. The bottom have him tagging along on someone else's stream, a truck, a street chant. With Shree he's a character, elsewhere a guest.

slices:Stereotypes.what: Anuj as a type: the creator checking his phone mid-breakup, the old-money poser in satin pajamas, the talent manager who got to the shoot first, the Mumbai vs Delhi friend.
slices:Stereotypes.why: Nothing on screen separates the best from the worst. It's one man playing a type in every one, and they all sit close together.

slices:Other.what: Three unrelated posts: Bigg Boss gossip in a vlog, a plain graphic for a jokes show, and a ranking of Revolutionaries characters.
slices:Other.why: The Bigg Boss lore post is the only one that landed: him talking TV gossip on camera. The graphic and the ranking meme did nothing. Too few to say more.

slices:Life dump.what: Carousels and Tokyo trip clips: screenshots of his pay, quote cards of his own lines, nightlife selfies, a stack of yen, a train platform fit check.
slices:Life dump.why: The money ones win: the salary-vs-earnings screenshots at 6× and the yen stack in Tokyo. The weak ones are him just being somewhere, day one wandering the arcades, spinning on a platform, nightlife portraits. Flexing wins over touring.

slices:Football.what: Football as a bit: Anuj as a crying Ronaldo and a relaxed Messi in a car, a blind tier ranking of ten players, a Manchester City badge kiss.
slices:Football.why: All three sit near his usual, so there is little to split. The one where he plays both Ronaldo and Messi is the highest; the badge kiss, a bit about paying a bill, the lowest.

slices:Brand ad.what: Paid posts: a product dropped into a skit (Myntra delivery agent, Pierre Cardin therapist), a plain visit or review, and event carousels.
slices:Brand ad.why: The best feel like his own: the BMW dinner ride, the fake floor-20 lie busted by a delivery agent. The worst are him pitching to camera: the body care review, the trophy poses, the Solana pitch.

sides:Shot at home|Collabs|top.what: Anuj and Shree trading lines, in a bed or a car, captions about money, food and sleep. Without it he's on a street, stream or set with other people.
sides:Shot at home|Collabs|top.why: Her bits sit at the top: the money and food ones at 40× and 18×. The weak ones in it react to someone else's video: the bed duet, the Haanikaarak Bapu band. Without it: streams, a truck, a podcast set.

sides:Designed graphic (style)|Life dump.what: Quote cards of his own lines, the photoshopped Indian Drake, and the salary screenshots. Without it, mostly Tokyo trip clips and photo dumps of him posing.
sides:Designed graphic (style)|Life dump.why: One post carries the side: the salary screenshots at 6×. The quote cards and Drake edits sit near his usual or under it. Without it the posts are patchier, a yen reel at 2.2× down to nightlife portraits at 0.4×.

sides:Two people on screen||ct.what: Shree duets plus brand skits, streams and gym bits where Anuj has a partner. Without it, he's alone in most of the loudest reels.
sides:Two people on screen||ct.why: Who the second person is matters more than having one. Shree bits top it; livestream clips and the gym partner skit sit at the bottom. The big solo political reel and the pavement rap are on the other side.

sides:Vlog / day-in-life (style)||ct.what: Anuj walking through places: Tokyo streets, a tattoo studio, Hyrox, a liquor store, a night drive with friends. Without it, the skits where he plays someone.
sides:Vlog / day-in-life (style)||ct.why: Touring a place gets few comments, since he isn't being anyone. The exception is the pavement one, where friends act out fight moves to rap: a skit dressed as a vlog. That single post keeps the side from sinking.

streaks:run-Dev-001M85b.what: A travel diary run: a night drive over the Sea Link, street food, Tokyo streets, arcades, the yen stack, plus one Ruhee street chant.
streaks:run-Dev-001M85b.why: Everything in it is Anuj being somewhere, with no character and no one to mock. The one skit, the Shivani chant with Ruhee, slid with the rest.

streaks:DeowPIlsWag.what: Mostly brand work and event posing: the Premier League trophy, a tattoo studio visit, the Garba Gemini bit, the Solana pitch, plus a football ranking and a photo dump.
streaks:DeowPIlsWag.why: The run is made of paid or event posts with Anuj promoting or posing, not mocking someone. What ended it was the old-money parody, him alone in satin pajamas and sunglasses playing a type.

streaks:DdLZ9DVDH0k.what: Almost all caption-led skits: Shree bits, the Mumbai vs Delhi friend, the talent manager, the carplay opp, a Cadbury brownie ad, and a meme carousel.
streaks:DdLZ9DVDH0k.why: Nearly all one-line captions with Anuj playing a character, the Shree bits at the top at 40× and 10×. A plain photo carousel of Bombay ended it.

followers:t10.what: His Top 10% posts: the politics reel, two Shree bits, the pavement rap, the diploma reel and the salary screenshots.
followers:t10.why: The politics reel, the Shree bits and the salary screenshots brought followers. The pavement rap, at 51×, and the diploma lip-sync, at 17×, brought none, even with likes that big. Loud likes alone don't bring people over.

followers:2026-10-10.what: The politics reel went up that day. The day before, an Amazon price-guessing stream game and a group selfie carousel.
followers:2026-10-10.why: The politics reel is the only loud thing in that window, 338×. The stream game and selfies before it were ordinary, so they can't explain a day like this.

followers:2026-10-21.what: A skit on 20 Oct about checking his phone mid-breakup, then a night drive in his BMW on the day itself.
followers:2026-10-21.why: Both ordinary, and neither explains a loss that size.

formats:Reels.what: Skits, duets, streams, memes and vlogs: nearly everything he posts.
formats:Reels.why: Every big post is a reel: politics, pavement rap, Shree, Bigg Boss. So are the bottom ones: the body care review, the train platform fit check, the Revolutionaries ranking. The format doesn't separate them, whether he's playing someone does.

formats:Carousels.what: Photo dumps, quote cards of his own lines, event poses and a salary screenshot pair.
formats:Carousels.why: Only the salary-vs-earnings screenshots broke out, at 6×. The quote cards, Tokyo snaps and event poses stay near or under his usual. He's mostly posing in them, not playing anyone.

formats:Photos.what: A single poster for a Liverpool vs Manchester City watchalong with six creators.
formats:Photos.why: Only one, so there's nothing to compare. It's an announcement graphic, not Anuj doing anything.
